changelog:
- Initial release of sales-pipeline-agent.
- Manage B2B sales pipelines end-to-end: track deals, log activities, and monitor pipeline health.
- Weighted forecasting by deal stage for accurate revenue predictions.
- AI-assisted lead qualification, stale deal alerts, and auto-drafted outreach emails.
- All data stored locally in a JSON database; no API keys or cloud required.
- Free to use with full command examples and agent script included for easy setup.
